title: ProductPrd:Workflow

_meta.purpose: Workflow product PRD — machine-optimized canonical form. Pointers to ADRs, specs, contracts, crates, lanes. Companion to /specs/microservices/workflow-studio.json (visual-editor half) + /specs/microservices/ontology.json (typed-entity backbone).

acceptance_criteria.given: valid workflow-spec.v1.json with state-machine + DAG
acceptance_criteria.when: WorkflowEngine::deploy()

acceptance_criteria.given: executing workflow instance
acceptance_criteria.when: step transition fires
acceptance_criteria.then: audit-chain row emitted with distinct timestamp + session_id per row

acceptance_criteria.given: two workflow definitions same id different versions
acceptance_criteria.when: caller resolves by definition_id@version
acceptance_criteria.then: correct version executes; no implicit version-bump

acceptance_criteria.given: definition with jurisdiction overlay
acceptance_criteria.when: executed in matching cell
acceptance_criteria.then: overlay rules override base; base elsewhere

acceptance_criteria.given: instance executing >1 hour
acceptance_criteria.when: engine restart mid-execution
acceptance_criteria.then: resumes from last persisted step; zero duplicate side-effects (idempotency)

acceptance_criteria.given: instance touching tenant data
acceptance_criteria.when: any data access
acceptance_criteria.then: per-tenant cell routing + Cedar policy gate fires; no cross-tenant leak

acceptance_criteria.given: agentic role calling invoke_capability()
acceptance_criteria.when: capability registered in Foundry registry
acceptance_criteria.then: Cedar policy enforces autonomy_tier; emits audit row

acceptance_criteria.given: new definition deployed
acceptance_criteria.when: schema migration policy invoked
acceptance_criteria.then: reversible migration; dry-run gate green before commit
